Container.Name: skoda-mate
Container.Overview: Trip tracking, charge logging and remote control for Skoda cars via the official MySkoda Public API.
Container.Description:
Self-hosted dashboard for your Skoda: trips, charging sessions, costs, battery and remote control (charging, climate, charging profiles), based on the official MySkoda Public API and a local SQLite database. Optionally publishes about 40 entities to Home Assistant via MQTT discovery. No cloud account beyond the API key you create in the MySkoda app; the key, the S-PIN and the database stay in this path.
First start: open the WebUI and finish the setup form (dashboard login, API key, VINs). Nothing is configured through environment variables. The Skoda API allows about 20 requests per hour per car, so a reading is taken every 20 minutes while parked and every 5 minutes while charging or driving.
There is intentionally no PUID/PGID: the app always runs as uid 10001, and the container hands the data path to that user itself. Set the data path to a private folder (not exported over SMB) - it holds the key that decrypts your Skoda API key.
Image: steffenr/skoda-mate from Docker Hub (AGPL-3.0-only) - see docs/UNRAID.md. Against a reverse proxy, add --proxy-headers --forwarded-allow-ips=172.16.0.0/12 to the extra parameters, with your proxy's network instead of the example range.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Container port 8080; change the host side if 8080 is taken.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database, secret.key and (first run) setup-code.txt. Back it up, keep it private, never delete it.

Config.Name: Cookie Secure
Config.Description: 'true' forces the Secure session cookie. Leave empty: Mate sets it by itself when a proxy sends X-Forwarded-Proto: https.

Config.Name: API token
Config.Description: Optional bearer token for scripts calling the JSON API. Empty = off.

Config.Name: Setup code
Config.Description: Optional: your own one-time first-run setup code. Empty = generated and written to setup-code.txt in the data path.

Config.Name: Demo mode
Config.Description: '1' runs a fictional car with 60 days of history - no account, no network. Handy for a first look.

Config.Name: Demo cars
Config.Description: Number of fictional cars in demo mode (2 tries the car switcher).
